answer: Because the dune stake is held until the meadow settlement, the operator carries real capital per endorsement, and the lotus audit lists each exposure. An attester must stake 30% of the reward its attestation would unlock, so endorsing a high-value answer costs proportionally more than endorsing a cheap one. A farm running 100 keys therefore burns that exposure on every endorsement it manufactures, which removes the asymmetry that normally makes mass attestation cheap. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
